'''Barlok''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Barlok system/Legends|Barlok system]] of the [[Marcol sector/Legends|Marcol sector]], between three and six days of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was also a member world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was known for [[tisvollt]] forests, inhabited by the indigenous [[Karf]]s; its agricultural produce, including delicious [[prisht fruit]]; its sprawling [[Patameene District]], including the [[Starbright]] hotel, [[Panky's]] restaurant, and the [[Covered Brush]] housing ring; and its mines, the ownership of which was a point of dispute between the guilds of the indigenous [[Brolf]]i and the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], including the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

A Brolfi terrorist movement arose, viewing their leaders as having betrayed them to the Alliance. [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], on behalf of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], seemingly assisted them in an attack upon a discussion between the Brolfi Guildmaster and Magistrate [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]. In truth, this only catalyzed [[Jorus C'baoth]]'s success in resolving the dispute, making him seem a hero. This prestige allowed C'baoth to proceed unhindered with his [[Outbound Flight Project]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
